homematic_active.title: Homematic integration still active
homematic_active.description: Remove `homematic:` from configuration.yaml and restart before eQ-3 MAX! can take over the entities.

max_cul_active.title: Old max_cul integration still active
max_cul_active.description: The predecessor max_cul is still loaded and holds the CUL stick. Remove `custom_components/max_cul` and restart Home Assistant, then eQ-3 MAX! takes over the entities.

port_lost.title: CUL not reachable
port_lost.description: The CUL ({target}) has not been reachable for 15 minutes. USB: check the stick and the serial port. Network: check that the CUN or Cube is powered and reachable at this address.

stick_deaf.title: CUL stick receives nothing
stick_deaf.description: The CUL sends but receives nothing even after two resets. USB: move the stick to another USB port. Network: restart the CUN or Cube (a reconnect does not reset its radio).

set_away.name: Set away
set_away.description: Holds the thermostats at a temperature until the given time (MAX! mode temporary), then they return to auto.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature; empty uses the away temperature from the options.

until.name: Until
until.description: End time (local time); rounded up to the next half hour, must be in the future.

factory_reset.name: Factory reset
factory_reset.description: Resets a MAX! device to factory settings over the air and removes it from Home Assistant. Afterwards it must be paired again.

link.name: Link
link.description: Links two MAX! devices in both directions (window contact or eco button with a thermostat, wall thermostat with radiator thermostat, radiator thermostats with each other). Returns right away; window contacts and eco buttons get their part after their next telegram (open and close the window or press the button once). Progress in the sensor Verknüpfungen.

unlink.name: Unlink
unlink.description: Removes the link between two MAX! devices in both directions. Returns right away; window contacts and eco buttons get their part after their next telegram.

force.name: Leftover on this device only
force.description: Removes the partner from the first device only, even if the integration does not know that link. For leftovers of moved or swapped devices: the device keeps sending to a partner that no longer answers and reports radio errors. The partner itself gets nothing.

set_week_profile.name: Set week profile
set_week_profile.description: Writes whole days of the week profile to one or more thermostats (radiator or wall thermostat): up to 13 points per day, each a temperature that holds until a time (5-minute steps, the last one until 24:00). The thermostat follows it in mode auto. Waits for the acknowledgements; about 1.2 s of airtime per telegram, a full week is 7 to 14 telegrams per device.

weekday.name: Weekday
weekday.description: Days the profile applies to, or “alle” for all seven.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: List of points: temperature and until (hh:mm). The last point may omit until (24:00).

copy_week_profile.name: Copy week profile
copy_week_profile.description: Writes the week profile stored for one thermostat (its last acknowledged days) to other thermostats.

device_id.name: Source
device_id.description: Thermostat whose stored profile is copied.

set_time.name: Set clock
set_time.description: Sets the clock of thermostats to Home Assistant's local time now and waits for each acknowledgement. The week program follows the device's own clock. Window contacts and eco buttons have no clock.
